name: Keiki — Registration Confirmation Email

parameters.subject: You're registered! — Keiki Coders

_readme: Import into n8n (Workflows -> Import from File). Attach an SMTP credential to the Send node, activate the workflow, then copy the node's Production Webhook URL into .env as N8N_WEBHOOK_URL. The app POSTs { parent_name, parent_email, amount_cents, currency, items:[{child,class}] } — fields are read from $json.body.
